planner.description: Session 1: plan a task or ticket, run the in-workflow review and draft the PR in-session, and delegate only implementation to session 2 (plan-task skill). Read/reason/git-metadata only.

implementer.description: Session 2: implement an approved plan on a feature branch, kept alive across the review fix loop (implement-task skill).

reviewer.description: In-workflow fresh-eyes review of the live worktree before a PR exists; spawned by the planner, review-only, never edits (reviewing-pull-requests, local mode).

pr-reviewer.description: Standalone remote-PR merge gate: fresh-eyes review of an open PR from the repo root; may merge and tear down only on a clean verdict with explicit approval (reviewing-pull-requests, remote mode).
